name: production.pretty-prompt.com
description: Pretty prompt is a place where you can improve, refine, manage, and iterate on your expensive prompts all in one place.

_published_faq.name: How do I add production.pretty-prompt.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add production.pretty-prompt.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://production.pretty-prompt.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the production.pretty-prompt.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: production.pretty-prompt.com lists 19 MCP tools, including add_tag_to_library_prompt, create_library_folder, create_library_tag, delete_library_folder, delete_library_prompt, delete_library_tag, favorite_library_prompt, get_library_prompt, get_library_tag, improve_prompt, list_library_folders, and list_library_prompts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to production.pretty-prompt.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to production.pretty-prompt.com in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
